Hi Aisha — thanks for a great discovery today. Quick recap + suggested next steps so we can lock in an evaluation kickoff: 

Recap (from our call)
- Primary goal: validate automated clinical note summarization at a target latency of <120ms per request for 99th pct under expected load.
- Success criteria: 1) F1 > 0.85 on our sample prompts; 2) median latency under 80ms during single-session load test; 3) no PHI storage outside your VPC for the pilot.
- Stakeholders: Tom (Clinical Ops), you (Product), and Dev/Infra for integration.

Proposed next steps
1) 60–75 min evaluation kickoff (trial plan, roles, data flow, success metrics) + scheduling 90-min technical deep dive (model selection, prompt set, KV cache expectations).
2) We’ll share a short prompt pack (5–10 prompt templates) for your team to review before the kickoff.
3) Security/compliance pre-check: we’ll send the SOC2 excerpt and data handling note ahead of the technical deep dive.

Availability request
- Can your team do a kickoff the week of May 24? Ideal windows: Tue 9–11am PT, Wed 1–4pm PT. If those don’t work, send two windows that do.

I’m looping in Ben (solutions) to propose specific agenda items and Mina (engineer) for tech prep. If you prefer, we can do the technical deep dive as part of the kickoff and extend to 90 minutes.

Thanks — appreciate the momentum.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
